//: Nakama loads one JavaScript file, so `outFile` concatenates the sources into
build/index.js. There are no imports or exports: with `outFile` every file shares one
scope, which is how the runtime expects a module to be written.
`files` is listed in order rather than globbed, so the output is the same on every
machine and a diff in build/index.js means a diff in the sources.
ES5 because Nakama's JavaScript engine is goja, which is ES5.1 with parts of ES6.
